caseData.headline: Worth a look: invoices are fake, inflated or altered

findings.plain: invoices are fake, inflated or altered
the borrower has debt it has not disclosed

signals.explanation: 2 of 15 invoice documents show a different total from the borrower's data (read twice by the document model)
'Prairie Capital Partners LLC' holds a lien on the borrower ('Crescent Parts LP': all assets of the debtor) that the borrower never disclosed (filed before onboarding: may be a stale filing)

steps.title: Ask for proof of delivery for the listed invoices
steps.draft:
DRAFT LETTER — Ask for proof of delivery for the listed invoices
To: Borrower B0081, attention: Chief Financial Officer
Re: Facility monitoring — request for information (B0081)

As part of our routine monitoring of the facility, we have identified items we need to reconcile:
  - 2 of 15 invoice documents show a different total from the borrower's data (read twice by the document model) [ref S4-B0081-DOC_DATA_MISMATCH-0a348e31]
  - Reported receivables include invoices that S4 found altered, unpaid or implausible [ref S7-B0081-RECEIVABLES_QUALITY-25689edd]

Please provide proof of delivery and the customer's purchase order for each listed invoice by 2026-10-11.

This letter requests information to reconcile our records. It does not allege wrongdoing by any party.

[Credit officer], Wells Fargo

steps.title: Ask for the lien release or a payoff letter
steps.draft:
DRAFT LETTER — Ask for the lien release or a payoff letter
To: Borrower B0081, attention: Chief Financial Officer
Re: Facility monitoring — request for information (B0081)

As part of our routine monitoring of the facility, we have identified items we need to reconcile:
  - 'Prairie Capital Partners LLC' holds a lien on the borrower ('Crescent Parts LP': all assets of the debtor) that the borrower never disclosed (filed before onboarding: may be a stale filing) [ref S5-B0081-COMPETING_LIEN-4826f9df]

Please provide for each listed filing, a copy of its termination statement (UCC-3) or a payoff letter from the secured party showing the debt was repaid, and for any listed judgment, evidence that it has been paid by 2026-10-11.

This letter requests information to reconcile our records. It does not allege wrongdoing by any party.

[Credit officer], Wells Fargo
